title: Salesforce–NetSuite Sync for Household Brands Serving Janitorial Distributors
summary: Salesforce distributor accounts map to the NetSuite customer that pays, while end facilities and ship-to sites stay visible without becoming customers.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Connect janitorial distributor relationships to the finance-owned customer and the correct delivery locations. Salesforce can maintain account activity and commercial context while NetSuite remains authoritative for accepted customer terms and financial status. Distinguish a distributor from the end facility it serves before assigning orders or balances.


Explore the complete[household consumables integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/household-consumables) for the systems and processes around this guide.
